licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score: contradirci (the libretto has contradirici), “il scoprimento”, the men's added “si” (yes) in “scorrerà, si, e a torrenti”, Signor, fù, perchè.

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 347–351, bars 441–495 of No. 31
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the No. 31 Finale (671 bars) read in fourteen page ranges, sung lines and piano each by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the zoomed page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by eight fresh proofreaders (one fix in this section: the right hand's broken octaves in 16ths in bar 17). The German singing translation is left out. All the singers of this section have a staff throughout, with rests where the print leaves a staff out; singers who do not sing in this section are left out. Cut from the one-file finale at bars 441–495: from the Allegro (4/4) to the end of the Andante, before the Allegretto at the top of p. 352. Playback tempo: Allegro at ♩ = 140, then Andante from bar 26 at ♩ = 70, from René Jacobs's recording (harmonia mundi), whose track for this section and the next lasts 4:45 (this section about 2½ minutes).
